definitions.content: number and reference together expressing magnitude of a quantity

notes.content:
According to the type of reference, a quantity value is either

* a product of a number and a *measurement unit* (see a), b), c), d), e), h) and i)); the
measurement unit one is generally not indicated for *quantities of dimension one* (see f), and h)),
or
* a number and a reference to a *measurement procedure* (see g)), or
* a number and a *reference material* (see j).
The number can be complex (see e)).
A quantity value can be presented in more than one way (see examples a), b), and h)).
In the case of vector or tensor quantities, each component has a quantity value.

examples.content: length of a given rod stem:[5.34 "unitsml(m)"] or stem:[534 "unitsml(cm)"]
mass of a given body stem:[0.152 "unitsml(kg)"] or stem:[152 "unitsml(g)"]
curvature of a given arc stem:[112 "unitsml(m^-1)"]
Celsius temperature of a given sample stem:[-5 "unitsml(degC)"]
electric impedance of a given circuit element at a given frequency, where j is the imaginary unit stem:[(7 + 3j) "unitsml(Ohm)"]
refractive index of a given sample of glass stem:[1.32]
Rockwell C hardness of a given sample (stem:[150 "unitsml(kg)"] load) 43.5HRC(stem:[150 "unitsml(kg)"])
mass fraction of cadmium in a given sample of copper stem:[3 "unitsml(ug/kg)"] or stem:[3 xx 10^{-9}]
molality of Pb2+ in a given sample of water stem:[1.76 "unitsml(umol/kg)"]
arbitrary amount-of-substance concentration of lutropin in a given sample of plasma (WHO International Standard 80/552) 5.0 (International Unit/l)

definitions.content: ensemble d'un nombre et d'une référence constituant l'expression quantitative d'une grandeur

notes.content: Le nombre peut être complexe (voir l'exemple e).
La valeur d'une grandeur peut être représentée de plus d'une façon (voir a, b et h).
Dans le cas de grandeurs vectorielles ou tensorielles, chaque composante a une valeur.
